title: Purchase orders
description: Stock you buy from suppliers, from draft to receipt.
searchPlaceholder: Search by order number or supplier

editor.alreadyListed: This product is already on the order. Change its quantity instead.
editor.tooManyLines: An order can have up to {{max}} items.
editor.costHint: The unit cost starts at the product's current cost. When the order is received, each product's cost price becomes the cost on this order.

validation.money: Enter a valid cost (up to 2 decimals).

detail.noPayments: No payments recorded against this order.
detail.notBilledHint: Nothing is owed to the supplier until the order is received.

orderDialog.title: Mark {{number}} as ordered?
orderDialog.body: Use this once the order is sent to {{name}}. It can't be edited afterwards, but can still be received or cancelled.

receiveDialog.title: Receive {{number}}?
receiveDialog.body: Every item is added to stock now, each product's cost price is updated to this order's cost, and {{total}} is added to what you owe {{name}}. Received orders can't be cancelled.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel {{number}}?
cancelDialog.body: The order will be cancelled. Stock and balances don't change.
